text:
Dear Mr. Ferrara,

Your lease for Apartment 4B at Maple Court [1] on August 31. We would be pleased to have you stay for another year. [2] The monthly rent for the renewal term will be $1,250, an increase of $50. If you wish to renew, please sign the enclosed agreement and return it [3] July 15. Should you decide not to renew, we ask that you [4] us in writing by the same date.

Sincerely,
Carol Weiss, Property Manager

questions.explanation: A third-person singular present verb is needed for a scheduled future event.

choices: The elevator will be inspected next Tuesday.
You have been an excellent tenant, and we value your presence in our community.
Pets are not allowed on the upper floors.
Our office has moved to Elm Street.
questions.explanation: The sentence supports the invitation to stay another year.
'By' introduces a deadline.
One 'notifies' someone of a decision; 'reply us' and 'attend us' are impossible.

text:
Local Bakery Wins National Award

Sweet Crumb Bakery, a family-owned business in Greenville, has been named Best Small Bakery in the national Culinary Excellence Awards. The prize was [1] at a ceremony in Chicago on Saturday. [2] Owner Helen Park said the award is a tribute to her team, many of [3] have worked at the bakery for more than a decade. As a result of the recognition, Sweet Crumb plans to [4] a second location downtown next spring.

questions.explanation: The passive voice is needed: the prize 'was presented'.

choices: The city's annual marathon was held last weekend.
The Greenville Bridge will reopen on Monday.
Tickets for the concert cost fifty dollars.
The bakery was founded in 1998 and now employs fifteen people.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives background about the bakery before the owner is quoted.
After a preposition ('of'), the relative pronoun for people is 'whom'.
A business 'opens' a new location.

text: Introducing CloudDesk, the easiest way to manage your team's projects. With CloudDesk, you can assign tasks, track deadlines, and share files in one secure place. Sign up today for a 30-day free trial. No credit card is [3]. After the trial, plans start [4] $8 per user per month.

choices: The office will be closed on Monday.

Applicants must hold a valid driver's license.

questions.explanation: The sentence presents the product's popularity and leads to the users' reported results.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'works'.
The passive form 'is required' fits 'No credit card is ...'.
Prices 'start at' a given amount.

text:
Hi team,

I am writing to remind you that the quarterly budget review will be held on Thursday at 2 p.m. in the main conference room. [4] I would like to thank everyone for the hard work this quarter.

choices: The cafeteria has a new vegetarian menu.
Attendance is required for all department heads.
Please remember to update your parking permits.
The new employees will start next month.
questions.explanation: The sentence is about the meeting and leads to the request to bring documents.
The reports are needed for a reason: the comparison with the forecast.
'Should' is followed by the base form of the verb.
'Finally' introduces the last point of the e-mail.

text:

[2] No appointment is necessary, but patients who arrive early will have shorter waiting times. Please bring your insurance card, [3] you have one. Individuals who are allergic to eggs should [4] a doctor before receiving the vaccine.

questions.explanation: 'Free for' someone introduces the people who benefit.

choices: The hospital cafeteria offers a new menu.
Registration will take place at the main entrance.
The parking garage is being repainted this year.
Our staff will attend a conference next week.
questions.explanation: The sentence tells where to arrive and links to the remark about not needing an appointment.
The insurance card is requested only on condition that the person has one.
One 'consults' a doctor.

text:
Dear Customer,

For security reasons, we recommend that you change your password [3] you log in for the first time. Should you need any [4], our representatives are available Monday to Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

questions.explanation: The passive voice 'has been approved' fits the good news.

choices: Our branch on Pine Street has relocated.
You may begin making deposits immediately.
Mortgage rates will rise next quarter.
The bank will be closed on Monday.
questions.explanation: The sentence follows the opening of the account and precedes the online-banking instructions.
'As soon as' links two actions in sequence: logging in, then changing the password.
A noun is needed after 'any'.

text:
MEMO
To: All staff
From: Human Resources
Subject: Employee of the Month

We are pleased to announce that Joseph Rivera from the shipping department has been selected Employee of the Month. Joseph was chosen [1] his outstanding commitment to customer satisfaction. [2] Last month alone, he resolved over forty delayed orders. Please join us in congratulating him at the staff meeting on Friday, [3] a small reception will be held. Nominations for next month [4] submitted to HR by the 25th.

questions.explanation: 'Chosen for' introduces the reason for the selection.

choices: The shipping department will move to the third floor.
Safety training is scheduled for next week.
The company will open a new branch in Denver.
His dedication has been noticed by both colleagues and clients.
questions.explanation: The sentence praises Joseph and leads to the example that follows.
'When' refers to the time ('Friday') and introduces the event.
After a modal, the passive uses the base form of the auxiliary: must be submitted.

text: Escape to Lisbon with Horizon Travel! Our seven-day package includes round-trip flights, hotel accommodation, and guided tours of the city's most famous [1]. questions.explanation: A plural noun is needed after 'famous'.

choices: Each day offers a different adventure, from historic castles to seaside dinners.
Passports must be renewed every ten years.

Two actions are joined: book early and receive an upgrade.
An imperative is needed after 'so'.
